output.summary: The backlog growth is mostly self-generated, not demand or capacity. First-contact issues rose only 4%, and staffing is flat (38 to 37 FTE). Split children rose from 240 to 3,710 a month and duplicates from 410 to 2,770. The reopen rate rose from 6% to 23%, and the reopen definition did not change. Quick-win picking and aging of complex tickets began with the quota. The Billing-Compliance pod has no quota and stayed stable. Tougher targets or extra headcount would worsen or misdirect the problem. Suspend the per-agent quota and move to quality measures with ticket ownership. Classify the aged complex tickets to size the Engineering-bug contribution, which stays unestablished.
